name: RMIT Emeritus Professor John Jackson Scholarship for Vocational Education
summary: Up to $25,000 a year for RMIT vocational students in financial hardship starting a Certificate IV, Diploma or Advanced Diploma in 2027.
key: Up to $25,000 per year ($12,500 per semester).
who: Starting full-time study in Semester 1 2027 in a Certificate IV, Diploma or Advanced Diploma at RMIT
Financial hardship, such as a low-income Centrelink payment or Health Care Card
Not previously completed a program at the same or higher level
how: Apply directly with RMIT online (preferred) or through VTAC, with supporting documents
catches: Closes 2pm Tuesday 20 October 2026; late applications not accepted
Excludes Certificate IV apprenticeships and undergraduate diplomas

source.label: RMIT: Emeritus Professor John Jackson Scholarship for Vocational Education

evidence.quote: up to $25,000 per year ($12,500 per semester)
Apply online through the Victorian Tertiary Admissions Centre (VTAC) website.
